study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier provided in paper; study referred to as Kailuan cohort study

target_condition.evidence_quote: Hypertension is one of the most prevalent cardiovascular diseases worldwide; Gut microbiota dysbiosis contributes to the development of hypertension
target_condition.notes: Primary conditions are hypertension and pre-hypertension

country.evidence_quote: The Kailuan study is a prospective cohort study focusing on the Kailuan community in Tangshan, a large modern city in northern China.

location.evidence_quote: Kailuan community in Tangshan, a large modern city in northern China
location.notes: City in China where study cohort resides

body_site.evidence_quote: metagenomic sequencing of fecal samples from a cohort of 196 Chinese individuals

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: Bacterial DNA was extracted at Novogene Bioinformatics Technology Co., Ltd using TIANGEN kit
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Stool sample collection and DNA extraction

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: All samples were paired-end sequenced on the Illumina platform
sequencing_platform.notes: Paper states 'Illumina platform' for metagenomic; 16S uses 'Illumina HiSeq' explicitly

zigosity.notes: No twin study; no zygosity data applicable.

age_min.evidence_quote: Male GF mice aged 8–10 weeks were randomly distributed
age_min.notes: Age applies only to germ-free mice recipients. Human participants' age not reported in abstract or main results.

age_max.evidence_quote: Male GF mice aged 8–10 weeks were randomly distributed
age_max.notes: Age range applies only to germ-free mice recipients.

age_years.notes: Human participant ages not reported in paper.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.
antibiotics_current_use.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Exclusion criterion; all participants in human cohorts excluded if on antibiotics/probiotics within 8 weeks.

bmi.notes: BMI mentioned in correlation analysis (Additional file 5) but no specific values reported in main text for any subgroup.

dietary_restriction.notes: No dietary restrictions reported for participants.

disease.evidence_quote: 41 healthy controls, 56 subjects with pre-hypertension, 99 individuals with primary hypertension
disease.notes: Human cohort classified by blood pressure status. Mice cohorts not assigned disease status.

disease_details.evidence_quote: 41 healthy controls (SBP ≤125 mmHg, or DBP ≤80 mmHg), 56 pHTNs (125 mmHg < SBP ≤ 139 mmHg, or 80 mmHg < DBP ≤ 89 mmHg), 99 patients of HTN (140 mmHg ≤ SBP, or 90 mmHg ≤ DBP)
disease_details.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics
disease_details.notes: Classification based on systolic/diastolic blood pressure thresholds per clinical guidelines.

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; study does not measure tumor response or ORR.

disease_response_pfs.notes: Not applicable; study does not measure progression-free survival.

disease_response_pfs_month.notes: Not applicable; study does not measure PFS follow-up.

disease_response_recist.notes: Not applicable; study does not assess solid tumor response.

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: dramatically decreased microbial richness and diversity, Prevotella-dominated gut enterotype, distinct metagenomic composition
feces_phenotype.notes: Stool/fecal microbiota characteristics described for human groups and mouse recipients.

fmt_id.evidence_quote: donors for microbiota transplantation consisted of two patients of HTN and one normotensive control; Male GF mice...divided into groups...HTN...control
fmt_id.section: Methods — Animal experiments; Additional file 11: Table S17
fmt_id.notes: Study-specific FMT identifiers inferred from donor counts (2 HTN donors, 1 control donor) and recipient group assignments.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: donors for microbiota transplantation consisted of two patients of HTN and one normotensive control; Male GF mice...were randomly distributed into two groups and orally inoculated
fmt_role.notes: Human participants (1 control, 2 HTN patients) served as donors. Germ-free mice served as recipients.

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Study does not include neonatal birth weight data.

neonatal_delivery_procedure.notes: Study does not report delivery method.

neonatal_feeding_method.notes: Study does not report infant feeding methods.

neonatal_gestational_age.notes: Study does not report gestational age.

neonatal_preterm_birth.notes: Study does not report preterm birth status.

obgyn_birth_control.notes: No oral contraceptive use data reported.

obgyn_menopause.notes: No menopausal status reported for female participants.

smoker.evidence_quote: Patients suffering from cancer, heart failure, renal failure, smoking, stroke, peripheral artery disease were all excluded.
smoker.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics; Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
smoker.notes: Smoking status is an exclusion criterion for all human cohorts. All included participants are non-smokers.

treatment.evidence_quote: All the subjects in the hypertension group were newly diagnosed hypertensive patients prior to antihypertensive treatment; Drugs including statins, aspirin, insulin, metformin, nifedipine, and metoprolol were not used on the patients
treatment.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics; Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
treatment.notes: Exclusion of specific medications was to avoid confounding effects on microbiome and metabolites.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve cancer or tumor staging.

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve tumor staging.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: Prevotella-dominated gut enterotype, distinct metagenomic composition with reduced bacteria associated with healthy status and overgrowth of bacteria such as Prevotella and Klebsiella
biomarker_name.notes: Biomarkers identified from both metagenomic and metabolomic analyses; some are bacterial genera, others are metabolites

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: relative abundance of genes; abundance of genera; serum metabolic profiles
biomarker_unit.notes: Units inferred from methods descriptions; metabolites measured via LC/MS in serum; bacterial taxa reported as relative abundance

biomarker_value.notes: Specific fold-changes or exact numerical values not provided in most cases; comparisons are relative to healthy controls

disease_response_os.notes: This study measures blood pressure changes, not overall survival

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable to this study design

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not measured in this microbiome/hypertension study

feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: Prevotella-dominated gut enterotype; Bacteroides was most enriched genus in enterotype 2; 48.21% pHTN, 45.45% HTN found in enterotype 1; 73.17% controls found in enterotype 2
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal microbiota phenotypes identified via metagenomic sequencing and enterotype classification

tumor_size_measurement.notes: No tumor measurements; hypertension study, not oncology

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable to hypertension microbiome study

value: Study cohort: 41 healthy controls, 56 pre-hypertensive subjects, 99 hypertensive patients
Source: Kailuan Group Corporation cohort study in Tangshan, China
Metagenomic sequencing: 1211 Gb total data, 6.18±1.43 million reads per sample
Metabolomic analysis subset: 124 individuals (30 controls, 31 pHTN, 63 HTN)
Fecal microbiota transplantation: 2 hypertensive donors, 1 normotensive control to germ-free mice
HTN mice showed significantly higher SBP, DBP, MBP compared to controls (P<0.05)
Disease classifier AUC: 0.91 for HTN vs control; 0.89 for pHTN vs control
Exclusion criteria: antibiotics or probiotics within last 8 weeks; cancer, heart failure, renal failure, smoking, stroke, peripheral artery disease
All hypertension patients newly diagnosed, prior to antihypertensive treatment

uncurated_metadata.notes: Study design and key findings summarized

extraction_warnings: Paper reports aggregate cohort statistics (n=41 controls, n=56 pre-hypertensive, n=99 hypertensive) but no per-participant sample data. Sample-level extraction cannot be populated with individual-level attributes (age, sex, ancestry, etc.) as these are not provided at sample granularity in the paper.
Study name is not explicitly stated; cohort referred to as 'Kailuan Group Corporation' or 'Kailuan study'
Individual subject_id and sample_id are not reported in the paper
Age, sex, and ancestry data are reported only at aggregate/group level in Table S1 (Additional file 1), not per individual sample
Three sample rows inserted to represent the three case/control groups mentioned, but this is a proxy for the stratified cohort structure—not genuine sample-level extraction
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.

Batch 1 subgroups ['healthy controls', 'pre-hypertension', 'primary hypertension', 'germ-free mice with control microbiota', 'germ-free mice with hypertensive microbiota'] differ from batch 0 []; kept batch 0.
Age information only available for germ-free mouse recipients (8–10 weeks). Human participant ages are not reported in the provided paper text.
BMI values mentioned in the Methods (correlation analysis) but specific subgroup values not provided in main text.
Dietary information noted as relatively homogeneous ('differences in diets relatively small') due to cohort environment but no specific dietary restrictions reported.
HLA typing not performed or reported.
Neonatal parameters (birth weight, delivery method, feeding, gestational age, preterm status) not applicable; study includes adult humans and mice, not neonates.
Obstetric/gynecology parameters (birth control, lactation, menopause, pregnancy) not reported.
Gender ratio noted as 'discrepant among groups' (Additional file 1: Table S1) but specific gender breakdown not provided in main text.
Disease response metrics (ORR, PFS, RECIST) not applicable; this is not an oncology trial.
Smoking explicitly excluded; all participants are non-smokers by design.
All listed medications (statins, aspirin, insulin, metformin, nifedipine, metoprolol) were excluded to prevent confounding; thus reported as 'No' use.
FMT donor identifiers and recipient counts inferred from narrative; no explicit study IDs provided in paper.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.
Field 'ecog_performance_status' not applicable to this hypertension microbiome study
Fields 'disease_response_os', 'tumor_size_measurement', 'tumor_size_residual_measurement' designed for oncology studies; not relevant here
Biomarker values represent relative changes (elevated/decreased) rather than absolute quantitative values in most cases
Metabolomic biomarkers have specific numerical values reported in supplementary tables but not detailed in main text
Study includes animal model (germ-free mice receiving fecal transplants) but schema requests host_species singular; primary study population is human
